address: 57 Los Gatos-Saratoga Rd., Los Gatos, 95032, USA
bio: ASA South is like your good looking friend, who also just so happens to be the perfect dining companion. The space is plain likable, featuring a chic dining room set with sleek furnishings, silver bark-like wallpaper and black-and-white photos. And then there's the kitchen, which doesn't take itself too seriously and manages to infuse a bit of fun into its repertoire of serious food. Case in point? The signature rigatoni with mushrooms, described as having too many ingredients to list. But, rest assured as they do a bang-up job. There's something for everyone on this wide-reaching carte, especially if you're a lover of fish—sustainably harvested, of course.The horseshoe-shaped bar out front is an ideal perch for a sip or solo meal....
